experiment.note: Use only metrics actually returned by the authorized Page Insights integration; do not infer missing values. No Page-specific timing conclusion is available until enough comparable observations are recorded.

notes: Autonomous mode means eligible posts do not require routine per-post approval; it does not override publishingEnabled=false, dryRun=true, emergencyStop=true, identity/permission checks, policy blockers, or an uncertain remote outcome.
Publishing is deliberately disabled and dry-run enabled until the exact Nature Frontiers Page connection is securely configured and independently verified.
The Page ID must be supplied through secure configuration and verified against Meta. No ID, token, permission, or live acceptance is assumed.

All policy uncertainty, missing source checks, missing rights evidence, unknown media provenance, unapproved destinations, duplicates, and uncertain publish results block the affected slot automatically.
History and attempt ledger paths must point to durable operator-controlled storage in production; GitHub Actions artifacts are diagnostic exports only.
The Nature Frontiers Facebook destination is separate from the SonicVhibez YouTube destination.
